observation: Builder session timed out mid-green-phase (step 7 probe implementation). Red tests committed (6681fd4f), probe code left uncommitted in working tree. Second builder spawned to assess state, run verify, and commit (99904168). Cost: interrupt + assess + resume cycle. This is 3rd occurrence (U1, S1, AH5) of L/M full-stack green-phase timeout pattern.

Static guard script (ah5-no-mock-guard.ts) had parse error (JSDoc */ inside glob **/threads/**/messages closed the comment block prematurely). Script never ran, but npm run check + npm run lint did not catch it (tsx error, not tsc/biome error). Guard was wired into CI but never executed until Phase 4 review tried to run it. Gap: static guards without proof-of-execution are indistinguishable from passing guards. Guards must be tested: run scripts in verify, assert exit-code 0, inject violations and assert non-zero.

AC3 (real tool action, observable) assertion deferred entirely to test.fixme() gate (AH3-owned UI trigger). Probe logged write_session_notes tool-call event but never asserted it. Result: probe passed on outcome===completed && cost>0 while model silently emitted prose and never called the tool. This is 'green while dead' (AH track HARD rule violation). Gap: test.fixme() gates hide AC gaps when the gated assertion is the only proof. Solution: mark fixme-gated ACs as requiring explicit replacement assertion (log-and-fail at minimum) so human knows something is deferred. Phase 4 fix (1015b20e) restored the assertion.

Project rule: e2e/expensive/live tests are LOCAL ONLY, never GitHub Actions; ci.yml stays fast+key-free. Root cause: spec AC4 'runs in CI' ambiguous (read as GitHub Actions vs local verification lane). Remediation: revert PR#301 -> re-architecture(9/10) -> rebuild -> Phase4 DONE. Implementation sound and preserved; only the venue was wrong. 2nd+ instance of expensive-test-in-GitHub-CI (AJ1 #287 precedent).
